nodes.label: Rabin-Karp Rolling Hash String Matching & Stream Deduplication Algorithm
nodes.description: Sub-linear stream parsing algorithm utilizing polynomial rolling hashes to detect duplicate n-gram sub-graphs and repeated text chunks across stream boundaries.

nodes.label: DMTF SPDM 1.3 Device Security Protocol for PCIe & CXL Hardware Attestation
nodes.description: Security Protocol and Data Model standard providing hardware component authentication, measurement attestation, and key exchange across PCIe and CXL device interconnects.

nodes.label: AraBERT Pretrained Language Model for Arabic Semantic Representation
nodes.description: Transformer model specifically architecture-tuned and pretrained on massive Modern Standard Arabic text corpora following Farasa segmentation preprocessing.

nodes.label: W3C SHACL Advanced Features SPARQL-Based Constraint Validation Standard
nodes.description: Extension to SHACL core defining SPARQL-based constraints, targets, and functions for executing complex graph-level business rules and validation queries.

nodes.label: GPU Direct Storage (GDS) & NVMe-Direct P2P Memory Bus Architecture
nodes.description: Direct peer-to-peer DMA path between NVMe storage controllers and GPU memory buffers bypasses CPU host memory to achieve maximum I/O throughput in knowledge processing.
